trend_method: Current cycle: Bayesian poll aggregate (a smooth, damped trend from the previous result, adjusting for each pollster's house effect and sample size; bands are 90% credible intervals; 2PP implied from primaries via estimated preference flows). Earlier cycles: simple 60-day kernel average of published polls.

events.description: Annastacia Palaszczuk elected as Leader of the Labor Party
Deb Frecklington becomes leader of the Liberal National Party and Leader of the Opposition
Annastacia Palaszczuk announces her intention to resign as leader of Queensland Labor and Premier of Queensland.
Steven Miles is elected leader of Queensland Labor; sworn in as Premier of Queensland.
The LNP defeats the KAP in the Hinchinbrook by-election
The ALP wins the Stafford by-election
